title: Climbable
description: A datapack that add some additional climbable blocks.
body:
Hello everyone, this pack was created because I felt there weren't enough blocks you could climb on. This pack modify the game data so that you can now climb on: 
- Chains
- Sculk veins
- Traps
- Metal bars
- End rods
- Spider webs (This can take a little while...)
- String

Hope you enjoy this little pack...
